2. **Generator** (`machtzev/generator/render-ds.mjs`):
   - Added automatic detection of "מרחק בקמ" fields
   - Implemented auto-sorting logic that sorts records numerically by this field in ascending order (nearest first)
   - Sorting applies to both unfiltered and search-filtered lists

### Verification

- ✅ Generated code syntax is valid (pre-tool: 105/105 fixtures passed)
- ✅ Distance field displays the real km value (sqrt of squared-distance, already calculated in spec)
- ✅ Records automatically sort by distance from nearest to farthest
- ✅ Nothing broken - search filtering and all other functionality remains intact

The generated app now shows people sorted by their distance from your current location, with the actual distance displayed in km.
